title: Canonical Header Branch Machine
statement: For every machine format $F$, there exist a finite Turing machine $C$ over the Boolean alphabet with at least one work tape, an entry state, an exit state, and a constant $a\\in\\mathbb N$. On every Boolean input $x$, it reaches within $t\\le a(|x|+1)$ steps, with $t>0$, the configuration in the exit state whose tape words consist of the canonical header of $x$ on tape zero and empty words on all other tapes; the input head is at position $1$ and the output is empty. At every time $u<t$ its state is not the exit state.
hypotheses_covered: no state at times $u<t$ equals the exit state
final configuration has canonical header on tape zero, other tapes blank, input head at 1, and empty output
